AftercarePage.metaDescription: Before and aftercare for brow and lip micropigmentation, with confirmed guidance and WhatsApp support.
AftercarePage.title: Before and aftercare for your micropigmentation appointment
AftercarePage.description: A practical guide to prepare your skin and care for brows or lips after the procedure. For personal questions, message us on WhatsApp before your appointment.
AftercarePage.beforeBrowsIntro: Preparing the skin before brow micropigmentation supports pigment retention and helps reduce bleeding or sensitivity during the appointment.
AftercarePage.beforeLipsIntro: Preparing the lips correctly supports healing, comfort during the procedure and better pigment retention.
AftercarePage.noteTitle: Every case is confirmed on WhatsApp
AftercarePage.note: These recommendations are based on official Cejas Internacionales content and do not replace medical advice. Always share allergies, pregnancy, breastfeeding, health conditions or medication before your appointment.

beforeBrows.title: 7 days before
items: Avoid intense sun exposure and sunburn.
Do not have chemical peels, microdermabrasion or exfoliating treatments on the area.
Pause retinoids around the brow area unless your doctor advises otherwise.
Avoid excessive brow shaping or hair removal before the assessment.

beforeBrows.title: 48-72 hours before
items: Avoid alcohol.
Reduce caffeine and energy drinks.
Do not take blood thinners or anti-inflammatory medication without medical authorization.

beforeBrows.title: On the day
items: Arrive with clean skin and no brow makeup.
Avoid creams, oils or cosmetics on the area.
Rest well and eat something light before the session.
Share allergies, health conditions, pregnancy, breastfeeding or medication.

beforeLips.title: 7 days before
items: Keep your lips hydrated with lip balm.
Exfoliate gently once or twice during the week.
Avoid sunburn and excessive sun exposure.
Do not have chemical peels or aggressive treatments around the mouth area.

beforeLips.title: 48-72 hours before
items: Avoid alcohol.
Reduce caffeine and energy drinks.
Avoid blood thinners or anti-inflammatory medication without medical authorization.

afterBrows: Protect the area from sun exposure for the next 8 days.
Apply the suggested vitamin for 15 days, morning and night, using a small drop on each brow.
Do not consume alcoholic drinks, spicy food or seafood.
Do not remove the micro-scab; let it fall naturally.
Do not apply creams, sunscreen, makeup or soap over the brows.
afterLips: Protect the area from sun exposure for the next 8 days.
Do not smoke and avoid kissing during the indicated healing phase.
Do not consume alcoholic drinks, spicy, hot or acidic food, or seafood.
Do not use lipstick or lip tints for one month.
Keep the lips constantly hydrated for 20 days with the indicated product.
Do not remove peeling skin during healing; it will fall naturally.

LegalNoticePage.metaDescription: Legal notice for Cejas Internacionales: owner details, informational purpose, contact, intellectual property and usage limits.
LegalNoticePage.title: Legal notice
LegalNoticePage.description: Website owner information, site purpose and general terms of use. This text is prepared for legal review before final publication.

sections.title: Purpose of the site

sections.title: Intellectual property and external links

The website may link to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or other external services under their own terms.

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: Privacy and data processing policy for WhatsApp enquiries, email, hosting and analytics with consent.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.description: Summary of personal data processing on an informational website with WhatsApp contact, email and analytics only with consent.
PrivacyPage.reviewNote: This policy covers Colombia, Spain/EU and Switzerland at an informational level and should be legally reviewed before publication.

sections.title: Data that may be processed
items: Data voluntarily sent by the user through WhatsApp or email.
Technical browsing data (IP address, HTTP headers) managed by the hosting provider.
GA4 analytics data only if the user accepts analytics cookies.
Non-sensitive events such as WhatsApp clicks, PDF downloads, language changes, market selection or map location selection.

sections.title: Purposes
items: Answer enquiries and manage appointments or reservations through WhatsApp.
Provide catalog and training PDF downloads.
Measure website performance and improve SEO/UX only with analytics consent.
Ensure the technical security of the website.
Comply with legal obligations where applicable.

sections.title: Legal bases for processing
items: Consent: for GA4 analytics cookies (Art. 6.1.a GDPR).
Pre-contractual or contractual measures: when the user contacts via WhatsApp or email to arrange an appointment (Art. 6.1.b GDPR).
Legitimate interest: server security logs and protection against unauthorised access (Art. 6.1.f GDPR).
Legal obligation: where required by applicable law (Art. 6.1.c GDPR; Law 1581/2012 Colombia).

sections.title: Retention periods
items: WhatsApp or email enquiries: retained for as long as needed to respond and manage the appointment, then deleted or anonymised.
Hosting technical logs: in accordance with the provider's policy, typically up to 90 days.
GA4 data: according to the retention period configured in Google Analytics (14 months by default).
In all cases, data is retained only as long as necessary for its purpose or to comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: Recipients and international transfers
items: Hostinger or the active hosting provider: manages servers and access logs.
Google LLC (Google Analytics): only if the user accepts analytics; Google acts as a data processor under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (DPF).
Meta Platforms / WhatsApp: when the user clicks a wa.me link and opens WhatsApp, Meta processes data under its own terms.
Social networks (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok): only if the user clicks the relevant links; each platform applies its own policy.
International transfers outside the European Economic Area (EEA) may occur with providers that have adequate safeguards in place (Standard Contractual Clauses or other recognised mechanisms).

sections.title: WhatsApp contact
items: When you click a wa.me link and start a conversation, the message content, phone number and associated metadata are processed by Meta Platforms Inc. under its terms of service.
Cejas Internacionales uses those messages solely to respond to enquiries and manage appointments.
WhatsApp conversations are not stored outside the application itself.

sections.title: User rights
items: Colombia (Law 1581/2012): right to know, update, rectify, erase your data and revoke consent. Contact: contacto@cejasinternacionales.com. You may also file a complaint with the SIC (Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio).

Spain / European Union (GDPR): rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability. Contact: contacto@cejasinternacionales.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the AEPD (www.aepd.es).
Switzerland (revFADP): rights of access, rectification, erasure and, where applicable, portability. Contact: contacto@cejasinternacionales.com.
We will respond to any request within a maximum of one month (GDPR Art. 12.3) or within the legally established period for the applicable jurisdiction.

sections.title: Minors
items: This website is not directed at children under 14 years of age.
We do not intentionally collect or process information from minors.
If you believe a minor has provided personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.

sections.title: Providers and no sensitive data
items: GA4 does not receive names, phone numbers, emails, photos, written messages or sensitive data.
Permitted GA4 events (WhatsApp clicks, downloads, language changes, market selection) do not directly identify the user.
You can view the list of permitted events and the Consent Mode configuration in our Cookie policy.

CookiesPage.metaDescription: Cejas Internacionales cookie policy: categories, consent, GA4 and preference withdrawal.
CookiesPage.title: Cookie policy
CookiesPage.description: Explanation of necessary cookies, analytics and preferences. GA4 is only activated if you accept analytics.
CookiesPage.reviewNote: You can accept, reject or configure non-essential cookies. Analytics are disabled by default.

sections.title: How we use cookies
items: Necessary cookies ensure the basic operation of the website (storing your cookie preferences).
Analytics cookies help measure visits and clicks only with your explicit consent.
Remarketing and Google Ads advertising are not currently used.
You can accept, reject or configure cookies from the banner shown on your first visit, or change them at any time using the link in the footer.

sections.title: Google Analytics 4
items: GA4 does not load or run before you accept analytics cookies.
Google Consent Mode v2 is applied: analytics_storage and ad_storage remain in denied mode by default.
Allowed events do not include personally identifiable data: WhatsApp clicks, catalog downloads, language changes and market selection.
You can withdraw or change your consent at any time from the permanent footer link.

sections.title: Locally stored preferences
items: The website stores your cookie choice in your own browser using localStorage, under the key cejas_cookie_consent_v1.
This information is not transmitted to any external server.
If you clear your browser's local storage, the cookie banner will reappear on your next visit.

sections.title: Google Maps
items: The website uses Google Maps. The map does not load automatically; it only loads when you click the button to view the location.
When Google Maps loads, Google may set its own and third-party cookies (NID, CONSENT, SOCS, among others) in accordance with its privacy policy.
You can prevent Google Maps from loading simply by not clicking the map button.

sections.title: Consent validity and updates
items: Your consent is valid for approximately 12 months from the date you grant it.
If we add new cookies or the inventory changes significantly, we will ask for your consent again.
See the cookie table below for the full and up-to-date inventory.
